correctness.rationale: For all 14 cases (2<=n<=8, a=0,1), the geometric fixed-space barycentric orbit lemma identifies |X_n|^{s_a} with an orbit-face complex whose simplices are unions of whole admissible graph-edge orbits. Exhaustive recursive perfect-matchings and independent orbit enumeration (not a sample) match all invariant faces. An independent new standard-library implementation reconstructed all 14 actual orbit complexes, verified every elementary free-face collapse and all residual cores. In n=8 edge-axis, the original f=(13,49,63,31,5) and 65 collapses yield (8,15,8); spanning-tree contraction gives eight relators g1,g2,g3,g5,g1g4,g2g6,g3g8g4^-1,g5g8g6^-1. Seven legitimate 1–2 CW cancellations leave generator g7 and one trivially attached 2-cell, hence S1∨S2. For smaller n the remaining cores are points, graphs or three discrete points as claimed, proving n=8 first H2 occurrence within the fully exhausted domain; no statement is made beyond n=8.
